text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Monthly refits on the latest 12 months. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole ISO weeks of valid time. Rule at zero: same score. Below zero: the arm is better than the reference.'
text.tspan: 16 Primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Monthly refits on the latest 12 months.
Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole ISO weeks of valid time.
Rule at zero: same score. Below zero: the arm is better than the reference.
